grain: One value per production line per business day. Plant-day and plant-month values are the same calculation over all of the plant's lines and days, never an average of line or day rates.

unit.conversion: unit_conversion.pieces_per_uom, applied to both quantities before any sum
unit.unconvertible: quarantined from numerator and denominator and listed

period.day: business day = 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 plant local time, assigned by the recorded inspection time
period.month: calendar month of the business day

unknown_member.rule: an inspection whose line has no dimension row valid on its business day is reported under the unknown member and listed, never dropped

history.join: valid_from <= business_date < valid_to (open-ended when valid_to is null)

tests: components reconcile across line-day, plant-day and plant-month
a zero denominator gives no rate, never 0 and never an error
units are converted to pieces before summing
a missing dimension key is kept under the unknown member
history is joined on its validity window, so no fact is counted twice
the window counts business days from the plant calendar, not calendar days
